sourceFacts.fact: Acanthosis nigricans can be associated with insulin resistance or prediabetes.
It can also have medication-related or other causes and does not establish diabetes by itself.

layout: A wide evidence-board design with three large cards linked left-to-right by two DASHED arrows labelled small clinical interpretation. First card shows a plain coral question token, not a skin sample. Second has insulin-labelled paper coins beside a question mark, no cell or receptor. Third shows a blank checklist and magnifying glass. A separate neutral bottom band says: Other causes exist; this sign alone does not diagnose diabetes. Do not draw dark skin, neck folds, obesity silhouettes, thresholds or test recommendations.
